Block 70 (exact, for VARYING fields): U_n = (-1)^{n.x}, s_n = det D_n, rho_n = s_n D_n, R_n the coin's half turn for rho_n, V_n = R_n U_n: V_n H V_n = s_n H in any rate field; frame E -> rho E rho; twist theta -> rho theta; reach-two strain B -> B D (one side only); reach-three strain unchanged; Theta = sigma_2 x conjugation commutes with all five generators; A_n = Theta V_n (n odd) carries solutions to solutions in the same fields with the energy reversed: sixteen branches = two classes of eight exact copies under rates and reach-three strains, mirror images of each other; U_(111) reverses the energy of everything that hops an odd number of steps; the reach-two strain alone breaks it (tr H^3 = -735/8192 for an executed field). Block 72: block 66's requirement on the content (stress gradient = weight, from a per-tick relabelling-blind field energy) by species: exact f_j[V_n psi] = s_n D_j f_j[psi] (reach two), fP_j[V_n psi] = s_n fP_j[psi] (reach three, fP built from the two-step hop (1/2) C2_j[d2_j phi]), e[V_n psi] = s_n e[psi]; at leading order the requirement holds for all eight species under reach three and FAILS with the opposite sign for species reflected along the gradient under reach two. Block 73: the conserved translation-invariant operators of finite reach are a(k) + c(k) H; no scalar momentum of reach <= 1 is every species' own wave number; at reach <= 2 the only covariant one is (1/2) sin 2k_j (six second-order functions sin k_b sin k_c removed by the proper rotations); the part along the walk allowed is gamma sin k_j H, a second-order scalar. Block 74: the three responses under the maps: the frame's site stress Theta_a^j -> s_n D_a D_j Theta_a^j, the reach-two bond current J_a^j -> s_n D_j J_a^j, the reach-three bond current K_a^j -> s_n K_a^j; they agree at leading order for the first species, and K is every species' own stress: the frame serves species (000) and (111) and has the wrong sign in shear for the other six; reach two serves (000) only; reach three all eight. Block 75: on a closed lattice sum_z (Delta f)_z/f_z = sum_bonds (f_x - f_y)^2/(f_x f_y) for positive f; curvature member: never at rest on a closed lattice, whatever the signs of bodies at rest; simplest member (block 56): rest iff sum m > 0 > sum m w with the ledger exactly zero (both signs needed); a pair iff 1/|m_B| - 1/m_A = gamma (G_0 - G_d).
